picks.title: Pixel 11 starts testing ‘Call for Me’ to have Gemini phone on your behalf
picks.rationale: New agentic phone feature: Gemini places real calls for the user on Pixel 11, a concrete Duplex-style AI capability shipping to hardware.
picks.excerpt: Following Direct My Call and Hold for Me, Google is introducing "Call for Me" on the Pixel 11 series. Reminiscent of Google Duplex...

picks.title: This is how Google's 'Create My Widget' app will work on Android and Googlebook OS
picks.rationale: Generative UI on devices: the official Play Store listing reveals templates and categories for AI-built home-screen widgets, directly relevant to designers.
picks.excerpt: Google has officially listed a "Create My Widget" app on the Play Store, giving us a look at the templates and categories it will support.

picks.title: Microsoft stops insisting you need a "Copilot+ PC"
picks.rationale: Strategy shift in AI PCs: new Surface laptops drop Copilot+ branding, signalling how on-device AI is (not) being sold to buyers.
picks.excerpt: Microsoft's new Surface laptops forgo Copilot+ PC branding.

picks.title: Logitech refreshes legendary Blue Yeti microphone with 3D voice tracking and AI denoising — $160 Blue Yeti 2 sequel features real-time auto gain and color mascot screen
picks.rationale: Practical creator gear: the Blue Yeti 2 brings AI denoising and 3D voice tracking to a mainstream $160 mic.
picks.excerpt: A modern successor to the Blue Yeti.

picks.title: Tesla’s Optimus robot is going through growing pains
picks.rationale: Reality check on humanoid AI robots: Optimus production is stalled on dexterous hands, adding robotics to the section's category spread.
picks.excerpt: Optimus needs a hand getting its hands working.
